description: Create Layer 4 Release and Deployment Agent Workflows plus the weekly summary workflow. Includes release automation, canary deployment, environment sync validation, and a meta-workflow that summarizes all agent activity.
steps: Create .github/workflows/agent-release.yml: triggers on workflow_dispatch (inputs: version_bump with options patch/minor/major, pre_release boolean) and when label 'release' is added to a PR. Steps: (1) Checkout with full history (fetch-depth: 0), (2) Setup Node 22 + pnpm, (3) Determine version bump from input or conventional commits (feat = minor, fix = patch, BREAKING = major), (4) Update version in root package.json + apps/*/package.json using pnpm version, (5) Generate changelog from conventional commits since last tag using git log --oneline, (6) Create git tag (v{version}), (7) Create GitHub Release with auto-generated release notes + changelog, (8) Push tag and version commits. Permissions: contents write + pull-requests read. Concurrency: release-main (cancel-in-progress: false)

Create .github/workflows/agent-canary-deploy.yml: triggers on workflow_dispatch and can be called as a reusable workflow (workflow_call). Steps: (1) Checkout, (2) Azure login (uses azure/login@v3 with OIDC), (3) Deploy to canary revision with 10% traffic weight using az containerapp revision copy + az containerapp ingress traffic set, (4) Wait 60 seconds for stabilization, (5) Monitor health endpoint for 10 minutes (poll every 30s), count errors, (6) Calculate error rate, (7) If error_rate > 2%: deactivate canary revision + set traffic 100% to previous revision + fail with rollback message, (8) If healthy: promote canary to 100% traffic. Permissions: id-token write + contents read. Needs secrets: AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID

Create .github/workflows/agent-environment-sync.yml: triggers on push to main (paths: apps/**, .env.shared) and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout, (2) Run .github/scripts/check-env-sync.sh (created in FEAT-002), (3) If script finds missing variables, create/update an issue with 'env-sync' label listing all discrepancies, (4) If all variables are in sync, close any open 'env-sync' issue. Permissions: issues write + contents read

Create .github/workflows/agent-summary.yml: triggers on schedule (weekly cron: '0 10 * * 1') and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout, (2) Use GitHub API (via gh CLI) to gather stats from the past week: issues created by agent workflows (label:agent-created), PRs auto-fixed (commits with 'auto-fix' in message), security findings (label:security created in last 7 days), stale items closed, uptime incidents, (3) Format a markdown summary with sections for each category, (4) Create a new issue with title 'Weekly Agent Summary - {date}' and label 'agent-summary', (5) Close previous week's summary issue. Permissions: issues write + contents read + pull-requests read
acceptance_criteria: All 4 workflow YAML files exist with valid syntax
agent-release.yml supports both workflow_dispatch with version input and label trigger
agent-release.yml generates changelog from conventional commits
agent-canary-deploy.yml implements 10% traffic split with health monitoring and auto-rollback
agent-environment-sync.yml references the check-env-sync.sh script from FEAT-002
All workflows include workflow_dispatch, concurrency groups, and permissions blocks
All workflows pin action versions consistently with existing patterns (@v6 for setup-node, @v3 for azure/login)
verification: Run: python3 -c "import yaml; [yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-release*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-canary*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-environment*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-summary*.yml')]" to validate YAML

Run: grep -c 'workflow_dispatch' .github/workflows/agent-release.yml .github/workflows/agent-canary-deploy.yml .github/workflows/agent-environment-sync.yml .github/workflows/agent-summary.yml to confirm all have manual trigger
Run: grep 'canary' .github/workflows/agent-canary-deploy.yml | head -5 to verify canary deployment logic is present
findings: All 4 workflow files created and validated. YAML syntax confirmed valid. All workflows include workflow_dispatch trigger, concurrency groups, and permissions blocks. Action versions pinned consistently with project patterns (@v6 for checkout/setup-node, @v3 for azure/login, @v7 for github-script).
